purpose: Fourth independently reviewed batch. Every imported fact is supported by one continuous quotation from a current first-party airline page. A conditional channel means a documented policy route, never seat availability or final carriage acceptance.

provenance_defaults.reviewer: Codex — direct reading of official airline page

facts.condition_scope: The 8 kg ceiling includes the carrier. A dog alone above 8 kg cannot satisfy the passenger-cabin ceiling; aircraft, route, documents and booking conditions still apply.
facts.finder_effect: For a dog above 8 kg, do not offer Austrian Airlines cabin. At or below 8 kg, this ceiling does not itself confirm a booking.
facts.quote: The total weight of the animal and the carrying container must not exceed 8 kg.
facts.locator: Travelling with animals → Small pets in the cabin

facts.condition_scope: When cabin space is unavailable and applicable conditions of carriage are met; only a passenger hold route, not a cargo decision.
facts.finder_effect: Austrian Airlines hold is a documented conditional route. It is not an aircraft-, route- or document-independent approval.
facts.quote: If there is no space in the passenger cabin, cats and dogs may be carried in the cargo hold if required, subject to compliance with the applicable conditions of carriage.
facts.locator: Travelling with animals → Large animals in the cargo hold

facts.condition_scope: American-operated flight, permitted route and under-seat carrier; restrictions include aircraft, seat and destination.
facts.finder_effect: American Airlines cabin is a conditional route. Do not turn it into a confirmation for a large dog, a specific aircraft or a restricted itinerary.
facts.quote: On flights with American you can bring one pet carrier as a carry-on if: You pay the carry-on pet fee; Your pet stays in the pet carrier and under the seat in front of you the entire flight.
facts.locator: Traveling with pets → Carry-on pets

facts.condition_scope: American PetEmbark cargo process for pets that cannot travel as carry-on or checked pets; cargo booking and route rules apply.
facts.finder_effect: Cargo is a documented conditional direction for an ineligible carry-on or checked pet, never an automatic shipment acceptance.
facts.quote: American Airlines Cargo offers the American PetEmbark® service for pets that don’t qualify to travel as carry-on or checked pets.
facts.locator: Traveling with pets → American PetEmbark®

facts.condition_scope: The 8 kg ceiling includes the travel carrier. A dog alone above 8 kg cannot satisfy this ordinary-pet cabin rule; assistance dogs follow a distinct flow.
facts.finder_effect: For a dog above 8 kg, do not offer SWISS cabin. At or below 8 kg, do not infer acceptance from this negative threshold.
facts.quote: Dogs and cats weighing up to 8 kg (weight including travel carrier)
facts.locator: Travelling with animals → The following animals can travel in the cabin

facts.condition_scope: Ordinary dogs and cats over 8 kg including container or with an oversized carrier; snub-nosed breeds are excluded from hold carriage and country rules still apply.
facts.finder_effect: SWISS hold is a documented conditional route, not a blanket approval for every breed, airport or destination.
facts.quote: Dogs and cats that do not belong to snub-nosed breeds and weigh more than 8 kg (weight including transport container) or are travelling in a transport container exceeding the permitted size (max. 118 cm; 55 x 40 x 23 cm).
facts.locator: Travelling with animals → The following animals travel in the hold

facts.condition_scope: Ordinary pet dogs. The cited exception concerns falcons, not companion dogs; service-animal rules are separate.
facts.finder_effect: Do not offer Emirates passenger cabin to an ordinary pet dog.
facts.quote: Pets are not permitted in the cabin, with the exception of falcons between Dubai and certain destinations in Pakistan.
facts.locator: Unusual baggage and special allowances → Pets

facts.condition_scope: Emirates allocates the pet between checked hold and cargo according to individual circumstances. This fact does not say both are available for a given booking.
facts.finder_effect: Emirates hold is a conditional possibility only. Keep cargo and hold allocation to the carrier's case-by-case decision.
facts.quote: Depending on the individual circumstances, pets must be carried either as cargo or as checked baggage in the hold.
facts.locator: Unusual baggage and special allowances → Pets

facts.condition_scope: Emirates allocates the pet between cargo and checked hold according to individual circumstances. This fact does not say both are available for a given booking.
facts.finder_effect: Emirates cargo is a conditional possibility only. Never present it as a confirmed shipment or together with hold as a simultaneous choice.
facts.quote: Depending on the individual circumstances, pets must be carried either as cargo or as checked baggage in the hold.
facts.locator: Unusual baggage and special allowances → Pets

facts.condition_scope: Ordinary companion dogs. Approved service dogs and service dogs under training use the separate accessibility process.
facts.finder_effect: Do not offer Qantas passenger cabin to an ordinary pet dog.
facts.quote: Qantas does not carry any animals in the aircraft cabin, other than approved Service Dogs or Service Dogs under training.
facts.locator: Qantas Disability Access Facilitation Plan (July 2025) → 8.12 Other Animals

facts.condition_scope: Only at airports where Qantas agrees to carry the pet as checked baggage; crate, food, documents and additional carrier conditions apply.
facts.finder_effect: Qantas hold is a conditional route, never a worldwide or automatic checked-pet approval.
facts.quote: Some airports will require that your pet travels as freight and some will allow carriage in the hold as Checked Baggage; if we agree that your pet may be carried in the aircraft hold as Checked Baggage, you must provide proper crating and food for your pet.
facts.locator: Conditions of Carriage → 8.8 Pet animals

facts.condition_scope: Ordinary pet bookings are made with Qantas Freight; airport, documentation and Qantas conditions still determine carriage.
facts.finder_effect: Cargo is a documented conditional route, not a confirmed shipment or a promise to travel on the same service as the passenger.
facts.quote: With the exception of service dogs (see 8.9), all bookings for travel by pet animals must be booked directly with Qantas Freight.
facts.locator: Conditions of Carriage → 8.8 Pet animals

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats only, subject to cabin, route, booking and documentation requirements. The published weight limit differs between domestic Italy and other flights, so no global threshold is imported.
facts.finder_effect: ITA Airways cabin is a documented conditional route. Do not infer a single cabin ceiling across domestic and international itineraries.
facts.quote: Please note that as of December 1, 2025, pet transport is permitted only for dogs and cats, both in the cabin (PETC) and in the hold (AVIH).
facts.locator: Pets in cabin → Service overview

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats only, subject to hold, route, booking and documentation requirements.
facts.finder_effect: ITA Airways hold is a documented conditional route; it is not a booking confirmation.
facts.quote: Please note that as of December 1, 2025, pet transport is permitted only for dogs and cats, both in the cabin (PETC) and in the hold (AVIH).
facts.locator: Pets in cabin → Service overview

facts.condition_scope: Ordinary pets. Assistance dogs use a separate process. Aer Lingus requires ordinary pets to use a pet agent and aircraft hold process.
facts.finder_effect: Do not offer Aer Lingus passenger cabin to an ordinary pet dog.
facts.quote: Pets must be booked to travel with a pet agent, and they will be carried in the aircraft hold.
facts.locator: Baggage Information → General Animals & Pets Rules

facts.condition_scope: Pet-agent booking and aircraft/route restrictions apply; Aer Lingus Regional prohibits pet carriage and certain aircraft have unventilated holds.
facts.finder_effect: Aer Lingus hold is a conditional route. Do not present it for every Aer Lingus-marketed itinerary.
facts.quote: Pets must be booked to travel with a pet agent, and they will be carried in the aircraft hold.
facts.locator: Baggage Information → General Animals & Pets Rules

facts.condition_scope: The 8 kg ceiling includes the pet bag or container. A dog alone above 8 kg cannot satisfy this ordinary-pet cabin rule; route and advance-booking conditions still apply.
facts.finder_effect: For a dog above 8 kg, do not offer Brussels Airlines cabin. At or below 8 kg, this threshold does not confirm a booking.
facts.quote: The total weight of the transport container, including the animal, must not exceed 8 kg.
facts.locator: Cats and small dogs in the cabin → Which conditions apply for a transport in the cabin?

facts.condition_scope: A suitable container and animal-health conditions are required. Age, route, country, breed and advance-check-in restrictions apply.
facts.finder_effect: Brussels Airlines hold is a documented conditional route, not a blanket approval for every destination or breed.
facts.quote: Your cat or dog will be well taken care of and will travel in a ventilated part of the aircraft hold.
facts.locator: Cats and dogs in the hold → How will my pet travel?

facts.condition_scope: Small pets only, on most international flights; destination, aircraft, booking time and available pet capacity remain conditions.
facts.finder_effect: WestJet cabin is a documented conditional route, not an itinerary-specific acceptance confirmation.
facts.quote: WestJet accepts small pets in the cabin and as checked kennel on most international flights.
facts.locator: General entrance requirements for guests travelling with pets → opening policy statement

facts.condition_scope: Checked kennel on most international flights; destination, aircraft, booking time and available pet capacity remain conditions.
facts.finder_effect: WestJet hold is a documented conditional route, not an itinerary-specific acceptance confirmation.
facts.quote: WestJet accepts small pets in the cabin and as checked kennel on most international flights.
facts.locator: General entrance requirements for guests travelling with pets → opening policy statement

facts.condition_scope: Only pets that fit in an under-seat carrier; health, carrier, breed, destination and route restrictions remain applicable.
facts.finder_effect: Alaska Airlines cabin is a documented conditional route. Do not infer it for a dog whose carrier cannot fit under the seat.
facts.quote: Pets that fit in an under-seat carrier can travel in a cabin.
facts.locator: Traveling With Pets → Pets in cabin

facts.condition_scope: Subject to baggage-compartment policy, health, carrier, breed, destination and route restrictions.
facts.finder_effect: Alaska Airlines hold is a documented conditional route, not a specific-flight approval.
facts.quote: Pets can travel in our climate-controlled baggage compartment.
facts.locator: Traveling With Pets → Pets in baggage compartment

facts.condition_scope: Unaccompanied pets through Alaska and Hawaiian Air Cargo Pet Connect; cargo booking, health, destination and route requirements apply.
facts.finder_effect: Alaska Airlines cargo is a documented conditional path for an unaccompanied pet, never an automatic shipment acceptance.
facts.quote: Our Pet Connect@ animal travel program is available via Alaska and Hawaiian Air Cargo for pets traveling without an accompanying passenger.
facts.locator: Traveling With Pets → Pets in baggage compartment

intentionally_unset.reason: The reviewed passenger page names a cargo hold, not the site's separate freight shipment category. No freight decision is inferred.

American permits checked pets only for active-duty U.S. Military and U.S. State Department Foreign Service personnel on official orders. The current Finder has no eligibility input for that exception.
SWISS identifies country-specific cargo-only imports but not a globally applicable passenger Finder cargo decision.
The reviewed ITA passenger page establishes cabin and hold only. Cargo is intentionally not inferred.
A pet agent is required, but the reviewed page does not map that agent process cleanly to the site's separate freight category.
Cargo is mentioned for United Kingdom routes only. A route-specific exception is not promoted to a global cargo offer.
The reviewed official passenger page lists cargo as a travel option but does not provide a continuous global cargo-acceptance proposition suitable for this strict import.
